title: The Breast Cancer Awareness Initiatives Beauty Brands Are Running This Month
summary: From La Bonne Brosse to Lys Beauty and beyond, several brands are running promotions in October to support breast cancer research and treatment.

extraction.key_fact: 뷰티 브랜드들이 유방암 연구 및 치료를 지원하기 위해 시월 프로모션을 진행하고 있다.
